subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: able

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words.

 
 
• Brave: Ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage.
 
• Consistent: Acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate.
 
• Able: Having the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.
 
• Oblige: Make someone legally or morally bound to do something.
 
 
 
• So, as per the usage of the given words "able" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: We must be capable of controlling our emotions while driving.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Complete passage: *All drivers are affected by road rage, whether they are directly or indirectly (1) involved.__ Individual coping qualities **__(2) __**__influence__ the behaviour of stressful drivers. Instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control, drivers __(3) must__ learn to be patient. On the road, we must be **__(4) able__** to control our own emotions. Road raged drivers are also more likely to (5) __________ more traffic offences.*
